units.function: Embedded-Postgres integration specification for suppressing repeated Issue-bound wakes after consecutive successful runs with no Issue-visible progress, while reopening admission for new human input, failures or scoped progress.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat admission queries recent terminal Runs and activity-log events for the target Issue, then either persists a skipped AgentWakeupRequest with throttle metadata or proceeds to the normal adapter execution path.
units.keyDataModels: Issue-scoped terminal Run history and finish time, no-progress streak, nextAllowedAt cooldown, Wake reason/request actor, ActivityLog actor/run/action/entity provenance, resume intent and Issue-visible progress.
units.lifecycle: Two recent successful no-progress Runs suppress another event-free assignment and record the streak/cooldown; a later user comment activity admits work without first breaking the streak through execution; system comment wakes bypass the throttle, Agent-authored comments and explicit resume remain suppressed unless new human input exists; a failed latest Run or same-Issue run-linked comment admits retry, cross-Issue activity does not; long Runs count by terminal time within the lookback.
units.testAssessment: Eight focused integration cases cover streak threshold, cooldown receipt, new user input, system and Agent comment distinctions, explicit Agent resume, failure recovery, same-versus-cross-Issue progress and long-run lookback semantics. Missing are concurrent admission races, database uniqueness/lease fencing, clock skew, exact window boundaries, queued/running Runs, cancellation/timeouts, repeated failures, high-risk approval events, user/Agent impersonation, edited/deleted comments, authoritative comment existence, progress types beyond comments, Connector evidence, configurable policy and starvation/notification behavior. One test admits a system comment wake with a random commentId and no persisted comment, so it does not prove source authenticity.
units.designRationale: Reduce cost and noise from Agents repeatedly waking on unchanged Work, while treating genuinely new external input, failure recovery and Work-scoped visible output as evidence that another attempt may be useful.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs loop and spend containment that does not suppress accountable-human intervention, approval resolution or new evidence, and must explain why a Work item was throttled and how it can resume.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the Work-scoped no-progress streak, explicit cooldown receipt, finish-time window, cross-Work isolation and priority for verified external input. Compute admission from immutable Message/Approval/Evidence cursors and Connector attempt receipts, with typed outcome classes and per-risk policy. A comment is communication, not necessarily progress; require a semantic ProgressReceipt or changed evidence/result projection. Human bypass must reference an authenticated principal and persisted message/decision, while failure retries use separate bounded backoff/circuit-breaker policy. Use atomic compare-and-set or a scheduler lease for distributed admission.
units.responsibilityConflict: responsibleUserId is recorded but not consulted. User versus Agent significance is inferred from mutable activity-log actor labels, a system comment wake can bypass without an authoritative comment, and any Issue-visible comment can count as progress without proving result or responsibility discharge. The skipped wake carries operational metadata but no accountable owner, notification/override decision, permission/data snapshot or evidence digest.
